answer: Each agent locks a 2,000 POA escrow deposit, tinted with a distinct pigment marking its sponsor on the public referral graph. A sybil wandering in under ten fake names pays 20,000 POA up front, and the graph exposes the star-shaped cluster at once. Any peer may dispute with proof; a confirmed fake forfeits its deposit, and its sponsor is slashed too. An honest agent pays once, keeps its stake, and shares the nectar of the pool undiluted.
